title: Switching from clarinet to trumpet at Manual School
summary: Because the clarinet lacked the melody he moved to trumpet as his second instrument, played in the Manual School orchestra and won valedictorian honours playing Ave Maria.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Picking up the horn: first instrument and the trombone

blocks.x: All right. We did this say about six months, then I'm feeling good now, so I was going to school and then I was -- there was a boy named Arthur Lanier on the clarinet. I liked the clarinet and I was still studying the clarinet but I was playing the second part on the trumpet, so then I found that the clarinet didn't have the melody and so I said, I'd better change over to the trumpet and -- for the second instrument. So I begin to play the trumpet and by having the sense of Training melody, I was playing in the Manual / School Orchestra and I played a solo and I got the valedictorian and I was playing the melody, it was (humming) The sonority was pure.
